verdict.line: You lose if Camille lands Hookshot off a wall into a level-6 Ultimatum all-in before your attack speed stacks up; you win if you deny her E, force an extended brawl, and let Relentless Storm and W's heal-on-recast outlast her burst.

brief.thesis: Camille has no ranged poke and her only hard CC is Hookshot's knockup, which only works near a wall — outside that window she's limited to single-target Q and a delayed W cone. Volibear can contest from range with E (Sky Splitter, 1200 range) exactly as OP.GG's own tip says, and once melee range opens up, his stacking attack-speed passive and W's heal-on-recast make long trades scale toward him. The 44.7% head-to-head over 150 games says this edge isn't automatic: she punishes any trade you start without tracking her E cooldown.

theirWindow.when: near a wall with E up
theirWindow.what: She'll Hookshot off the wall for a knockup, then empower an auto with Q and follow with W's cone before you can react. Give walls a wide berth whenever her E icon shows ready.

yourWindow.what: Poke from brush with E (Sky Splitter) to slow and shield up, then step in, stun with Q, and land W twice for the on-hit mark and heal. With no E to disengage, your passive's bonus attack speed makes the fight get worse for her the longer it runs.

start.why: The measured top pick in this matchup (43.4% WR, 69.7% pick over 129 games) — the extra sustain and mana-adjacent regen cover the early all-in attempts off her Q poke.

boots.why: Measured top pick (44.2% WR, 50.3% over 86 games) — Camille's entire kit is basic-attack-reliant (Q empower, passive shield procs on your trades), so flat physical reduction blunts every exchange.

core.why: First item in the highest-winrate measured path (41.7% over 12 games); gives the early AD/haste to keep Q and W cooldowns low into her short-cooldown kit.
Stacks on top of Relentless Storm's bonus attack speed, directly compounding your on-hit W and shortening Q's stun uptime.
Completes the measured core path and turns W's heal-on-recast into real sustain during the extended brawls this matchup rewards.

situational.when: the game goes long and you want the extra damage amp to close out drawn-out fights
she's building lifesteal and you need the shield to survive her Ultimatum all-in
you want extra sustain and poke to go with Sky Splitter's range

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking attack speed layers directly onto Relentless Storm and W's on-hit mark, which is what turns the measured solo-kill advantage into real damage in an extended trade.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the standard pick (75.4% pick rate) for the aggressive, solo-kill-favored shape of this lane, securing kills before her passive shield or W heal can offset damage. Flash + Exhaust shows the highest measured winrate (58.3%) by directly answering her R (Hextech Ultimatum) all-in, cutting the bonus damage from her empowered autos.

playing.title: Poke from brush with E
playing.detail: Sky Splitter's 1200 range lets you drop the lightning bolt on her from inside brush without walking into Hookshot's 800-range chase. It's a 16s cooldown, so don't throw it away on a whiff.

playing.title: Save Q for her commitment
playing.detail: Thundering Smash only stuns the first enemy you attack, so hold it until she's already walked into your 300-range threat zone or committed Hookshot, not as an opener.

playing.title: Always go back for the second W
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul's recast on an already-marked target deals bonus damage and heals you — land the first W, then commit to the second before you consider disengaging.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown off walls
playing.detail: Hookshot sits at 16/15/14/13/12s. A missed or landed E means she's locked out of her only knockup for a full cooldown — that's your window to all-in without fearing it.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Ultimatum
playing.detail: Once she's 6, her R lets her dash in and anchor you while autos deal bonus magic damage. Don't overextend past the wave below 50% health once she has it up.

playing.title: Build into the brawl
playing.detail: The measured Navori Flickerblade path stacks attack speed on top of your own passive — prioritize finishing it over defensive items unless you're already behind on tempo.

playing.title: Use W to bait her into Q range
playing.detail: Both W (325) and Q (300) are short. Mark with W first to draw her in, then stun with Q once she's inside your range instead of trying to engage from max range.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and summoner picks above come from measured Volibear-vs-Camille games on the current patch (16.20.1); the cooldown tracking and trade-timing reasoning is our own tactical read, not OP.GG's.
